# LS Diet

> LS Diet is a low-starch, low-sugar lifestyle system created by Oscar Poon to stop weight regain through behavioural permanence and awareness training.

LS Diet teaches a sustainable, eat-until-full approach to permanent weight loss. The framework is built on three pillars — Awareness, Practice, and Permanence — known as the Weight Permanence Triangle™. Founded by Oscar Poon, who lost 80+ lbs three times before designing the method that finally stuck.

- [Why Low-Starch, Low-Sugar Is More Sustainable Than Extreme Dieting](/blog/why-low-starch-low-sugar-is-more-sustainable-than-extreme-dieting): Foundational pillar on why LS Diet outperforms restrictive dieting long term.
- [Reality Awareness](/blog/reality-awareness): Foundational pillar — Stage 1 of the 5 Awareness Stages. Honest self assessment as the baseline for permanent weight loss.
- [Friction Awareness](/blog/friction-awareness): Foundational pillar — Stage 2 of the 5 Awareness Stages. The tension between current behaviour and the future you want.
- [Pattern Awareness](/blog/pattern-awareness): Foundational pillar — Stage 3 of the 5 Awareness Stages. Repeated routines, environments, and triggers behind weight regain.
- [Consequence Awareness](/blog/consequence-awareness): Foundational pillar — Stage 4 of the 5 Awareness Stages. PUSH motivation and the long term cost of inaction.
- [Identity Awareness](/blog/identity-awareness): Foundational pillar — Stage 5 of the 5 Awareness Stages. PULL motivation and future identity as the engine of long term consistency.
- [Action Practice](/blog/action-practice): Foundational pillar — the implementation stage of the Weight Permanence Triangle™. Repeatable behavioural systems, environmental design, and accountability.
- [Free Resources](/FreeResources): Downloadable guides on the LS Diet and GLP-1 medications.
